subject: Next steps: cost targets, model buckets, and procurement timing
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@zenly.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-09T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Discovery recap and proposed next steps (token targets + model buckets)

Samira — great talking earlier. Quick recap and the asks we agreed to so we have a clean handoff into a pilot/POC: 

1) Volumes and cadence you shared: ~120M input tokens / month (mix of short queries and long session chat), peak-day at ~6M tokens.
2) Budget range you flagged: $6k–$12k / month initially, with ability to expand in Q2 if unit economics look good.
3) Key use cases: customer-facing chat (low-latency), nightly embedding batch for search, and a small rerank pipeline on top of embeddings for top-K.

Ask from our side (we agreed Samira/Alec would confirm these items):
- Finalize monthly volume estimate & peak-day estimate (we used 120M / 6M as call numbers)
- Confirm target unit cost you want to see (you mentioned ~$1k–$2k per 1M tokens as an aspirational figure)
- Model preferences: you said model quality for chat matters most>rerank>embeddings cost-sensitivity.

I attached a simple worksheet that maps a few plausible model blends to monthly $/1M token outcomes — please fill in or confirm the volumes per model column. From our side we can then produce a formal pricing quote and an estimated SLA/throughput plan.

Attachments: zenly-token-econ-worksheet.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Proposed next steps:
- You update the worksheet and return by EOD Thursday (2/11) — we’ll produce a tailored quote and a pilot SOW within 48 hours of that.
- Optional: 45-minute follow-up next week to review the model tradeoffs; I can pull Sergio in for unit-econ scenarios.

Thanks again — excited to move this forward.

— Monica
Monica Patel | Sales, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@zenly.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alec Turner <alec.turner@zenly.ai>
Date: 2027-02-09T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap and proposed next steps (token targets + model buckets)

Thanks Monica — great notes and yes, that matches our conversation. A couple clarifications from our PM (Alec) and me:

- Volumes: the 120M/month is our conservative 3-month forecast. If pilot performs, we'd expect to double by Q3.
- Peak/day: ~6M was right for our busiest days but please size for 10M as an upper safety limit.
- Budget: the $6k–$12k band is where we want to land initially. We were thinking of two scenarios for unit economics you mentioned:
  * Conservative: $2k / 1M tokens (higher quality baseline model for chat)
  * Aggressive: $900 / 1M tokens (blend heavier on quantized variants / batching)

Model preferences:
- Chat: high-quality chat model for live support (majority of latency-sensitive traffic) — goal: sub-250ms p95 generation.
- Embeddings: cheap 1536-d/4096-d vector model for nightly indexing (~10–15% of token volume).
- Rerank: very small percentage of total tokens but high QPS for top-K scoring.

We'll fill your worksheet and return by Thursday. Also open to the 45-minute follow-up — Tue/Wed next week looks best for us.

Cheers,
Samira
Samira Khan | Head of AI Products, Zenly.ai
samira.k@zenly.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@zenly.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-10T08:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap and proposed next steps (token targets + model buckets)

Thanks Samira — perfect. Two quick clarifying questions before we produce the quote: 

1) For the chat traffic, can you split the 120M into session types? Ballpark answers are fine. Example columns in the worksheet: short queries (avg 16 tokens), medium sessions (avg 120 tokens), long sessions (avg 900 tokens). That split materially changes our CPU/GPU sizing and suggested model.
2) For the aggressive $900 / 1M target — is that a hard budget cap for the pilot or an internal goal if we pursue quantized + batching strategies?

Sergio will draft two unit-econ scenarios: (A) quality-first (baseline chat model + moderate rerank) and (B) cost-first (quantized chat variant + heavier batching + smaller rerank). We intend to show per-model $/1M, and a blended $/1M in the worksheet.

Attached provisional pricing doc: redwood-pricing-quote-v1.pdf (quote stub)

If you can fill out the session split and flag whether $900 is a hard cap or aspirational, we’ll turn around the quote + SOW within 48 hours.

Thanks — looping Sergio for the unit econ scenarios.

— Monica
Monica Patel | Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira.k@zenly.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-10T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap and proposed next steps (token targets + model buckets)

Samira / Monica — quick unit-econ notes (sending the high-level numbers here so CR can be used directly in the worksheet):

Scenario A — Quality-first (chat: ql-7b, embeddings: emb-4096, rerank: rnk-small)
- Chat: $1,800 / 1M tokens (baseline ql-7b at standard throughput, minimal quantization)
- Embeddings: $120 / 1M tokens (batch jobs, lower cost)
- Rerank: $2,400 / 1M tokens (high compute per token but low total volume)
- Blended: assuming 80% chat / 15% embeddings / 5% rerank => ~$1,470 / 1M tokens

Scenario B — Cost-first (chat: ql-7b-quant / runtime batching, embeddings: emb-1536-fast)
- Chat: $920 / 1M tokens (aggressive quantization + guaranteed batching windows)
- Embeddings: $100 / 1M tokens
- Rerank: $1,900 / 1M tokens
- Blended (80/15/5): ~$900 / 1M tokens

Notes and tradeoffs:
- To hit the $900 blended target we recommend a pilot with guaranteed batching for non-live traffic and a small % of requests routed to a higher-quality fallback for latency-sensitive sessions.
- We can include an SLA with p95 latency targets for chat on the quality-first plan; cost-first plan will have best-effort p95 but firm throughput guarantees.
- If Zenly can commit to a 3-month reserved capacity commit (minimum 250M tokens/mo equivalent), we can offer a structured discount that pushes the blended price ~10–15% lower.

I’ll populate the worksheet with these rows and send back a version stamped for your review. Happy to jump on the follow-up to walk through the numbers.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez | Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
